results.name: Apple Inc.
results.long_description: Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; Mac, a line of personal computers; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and wearables, home, and accessories, including Apple Watch, AirPods, Beats products, Apple Vision Pro, Apple TV 4K, HomePod, and Apple HomeView, as well as Apple branded and third-party accessories. It also provides advertising services comprising third-party licensing arrangements and own advertising platforms; AppleCare and cloud services; and payment services, including Apple Card and Apple Pay. In addition, the company operates App Store that allow customers to discover and download applications and digital content, such as books, music, video, games, and podcasts. Further, it provides digital content through subscription-based services, including Apple Arcade, a game service; Apple Fitness+, a personalized fitness service; Apple Music, which offers users a curated listening experience; Apple News+, a news and magazine service; and Apple TV, which offers original content and live sports. The company sells its products and resells third-party products through its retail and online stores, and direct sales force; its services through its various service platforms; and third-party cellular network carriers and other resellers. It serves consumer, small and mid-sized business, education, enterprise, and government markets. The company operates in North and South America, European countries, India, the Middle East, Africa, China mainland, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, and rest of Asia. The company was formerly known as Apple Computer, Inc. and changed its name to Apple Inc. in January 2007. Apple Inc. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Cupertino, California.

growth_operating_revenue.label: Operating Revenue
growth_operating_revenue.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

growth_total_revenue.label: Total Revenue
growth_total_revenue.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

growth_operating_cost_of_revenue.label: Operating Cost of Revenue
growth_operating_cost_of_revenue.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

growth_total_cost_of_revenue.label: Total Cost of Revenue
growth_total_cost_of_revenue.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

growth_total_gross_profit.label: Total Gross Profit
growth_total_gross_profit.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

growth_sga_expense.label: Selling, General & Admin Expense
growth_sga_expense.description: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

growth_rd_expense.label: Research & Development Expense
growth_rd_expense.description: Amount of expense for research and development. Includes, but is not limited to, cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed and writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both. Excludes write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.

growth_depreciation_expense.label: Depreciation Expense
growth_depreciation_expense.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

growth_amortization_expense.label: Amortization Expense
growth_amortization_expense.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

growth_other_depreciation_and_amortizati.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization
growth_other_depreciation_and_amortizati.description: Synthetic balancing plug derived from Depreciation and Amortization minus explicitly mapped children.

growth_depreciation_and_amortization.label: Depreciation and Amortization
growth_depreciation_and_amortization.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives.

growth_total_operating_expenses.label: Total Operating Expenses
growth_total_operating_expenses.description: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

growth_costs_and_expenses.label: Costs & Expenses
growth_costs_and_expenses.description: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

growth_total_operating_income.label: Total Operating Income
growth_total_operating_income.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

growth_total_interest_income.label: Interest & Investment Income
growth_total_interest_income.description: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

growth_total_interest_expense.label: Interest Expense
growth_total_interest_expense.description: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.

growth_other_income.label: Other Income / (Expense), net
growth_other_income.description: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

growth_total_other_income.label: Total Other Income / (Expense), net
growth_total_other_income.description: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

growth_total_pretax_income.label: Total Pre-Tax Income
growth_total_pretax_income.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

growth_income_tax_expense.label: Income Tax Expense
growth_income_tax_expense.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

growth_income_tax_current.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
growth_income_tax_current.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

growth_income_tax_deferred.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
growth_income_tax_deferred.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

growth_income_before_equity_method.label: Income Before Equity Method Investments
growth_income_before_equity_method.description: Amount of income/loss from continuing operations before income from equity method investments.

growth_net_income_continuing.label: Net Income / (Loss) Continuing Operations
growth_net_income_continuing.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

growth_other_adjustments_to_consolidated.label: Other Adjustments to Consolidated Net Income / (Loss)
growth_other_adjustments_to_consolidated.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

growth_net_income.label: Consolidated Net Income / (Loss)
growth_net_income.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

growth_net_income_to_common.label: Net Income / (Loss) Attributable to Common Shareholders
growth_net_income_to_common.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

growth_weighted_ave_basic_shares_os.label: Weighted Average Basic Shares Outstanding
growth_weighted_ave_basic_shares_os.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

growth_basic_eps.label: Basic Earnings per Share
growth_basic_eps.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

growth_weighted_ave_diluted_shares_os.label: Weighted Average Diluted Shares Outstanding
growth_weighted_ave_diluted_shares_os.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

growth_diluted_eps.label: Diluted Earnings per Share
growth_diluted_eps.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

growth_cash_dividends_per_share.label: Cash Dividends to Common per Share
growth_cash_dividends_per_share.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

growth_other_comprehensive_income_parent.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
growth_other_comprehensive_income_parent.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of OCI attributable to parent.

growth_comprehensive_income_parent.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
growth_comprehensive_income_parent.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events, attributable to parent.

growth_comprehensive_income.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss)
growth_comprehensive_income.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events/circumstances from net income and OCI. Includes portion attributable to NCI.

growth_cash_and_equivalents.label: Cash & Equivalents
growth_cash_and_equivalents.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

growth_short_term_investments.label: Short-Term Investments
growth_short_term_investments.description: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as current.

growth_accounts_receivable.label: Accounts Receivable
growth_accounts_receivable.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

growth_nontrade_receivables.label: Vendor Non-trade Receivables
growth_nontrade_receivables.description: The sum of amounts currently receivable other than from customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_net_inventory.label: Inventories, net
growth_net_inventory.description: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

growth_current_deferred_tax_assets.label: Current Deferred & Refundable Income Taxes
growth_current_deferred_tax_assets.description: The current portion of the aggregate tax effects as of the balance sheet date of all future tax deductions arising from temporary differences between tax basis and generally accepted accounting principles basis recognition of assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses, which can only be deducted for tax purposes when permitted under enacted tax laws; after deducting the allocated valuation allowance, if any, to reduce such amount to net realizable value. Deferred tax liabilities and assets are classified as current or noncurrent based on the classification of the related asset or liability for financial reporting. A deferred tax liability or asset that is not related to an asset or liability for financial reporting, including deferred tax assets related to carryforwards, are classified according to the expected reversal date of the temporary difference. An unrecognized tax benefit that is directly related to a position taken in a tax year that results in a net operating loss carryforward is presented as a reduction of the related deferred tax asset.

growth_other_current_assets.label: Other Current Assets
growth_other_current_assets.description: Amount of current assets classified as other.

growth_total_current_assets.label: Total Current Assets
growth_total_current_assets.description: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

growth_gross_ppe.label: Plant, Property & Equipment, gross
growth_gross_ppe.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

growth_accumulated_depreciation.label: Accumulated Depreciation
growth_accumulated_depreciation.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

growth_net_ppe.label: Plant, Property, & Equipment, net
growth_net_ppe.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

growth_operating_lease_right_of_use_asse.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
growth_operating_lease_right_of_use_asse.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

growth_finance_lease_right_of_use_asset.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
growth_finance_lease_right_of_use_asset.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

growth_long_term_investments.label: Long-Term Investments
growth_long_term_investments.description: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as noncurrent.

growth_goodwill.label: Goodwill
growth_goodwill.description: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

growth_intangible_assets.label: Intangible Assets
growth_intangible_assets.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

growth_noncurrent_deferred_tax_assets.label: Noncurrent Deferred & Refundable Income Taxes
growth_noncurrent_deferred_tax_assets.description: The noncurrent portion as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate carrying amount of all future tax deductions arising from temporary differences between tax basis and generally accepted accounting principles basis recognition of assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses, which can only be deducted for tax purposes when permitted under enacted tax laws; after the valuation allowance, if any, to reduce such amount to net realizable value. Deferred tax liabilities and assets are classified as current or noncurrent based on the classification of the related asset or liability for financial reporting. A deferred tax liability or asset that is not related to an asset or liability for financial reporting, including deferred tax assets related to carryforwards, is classified according to the expected reversal date of the temporary difference.

growth_other_noncurrent_assets.label: Other Noncurrent Operating Assets
growth_other_noncurrent_assets.description: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

growth_total_noncurrent_assets.label: Total Noncurrent Assets
growth_total_noncurrent_assets.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_total_assets.label: Total Assets
growth_total_assets.description: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

growth_short_term_debt.label: Short-Term Debt
growth_short_term_debt.description: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_current_portion_of_long_term_debt.label: Current Portion of Long-Term Debt
growth_current_portion_of_long_term_debt.description: Amount of long-term debt due within one year or within the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_accounts_payable.label: Accounts Payable
growth_accounts_payable.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

growth_accrued_expenses.label: Accrued Expenses
growth_accrued_expenses.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

growth_current_deferred_revenue.label: Current Deferred Revenue
growth_current_deferred_revenue.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

growth_current_employee_benefit_liabilit.label: Current Employee Benefit Liabilities
growth_current_employee_benefit_liabilit.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

growth_other_taxes_payable.label: Other Taxes Payable
growth_other_taxes_payable.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

growth_other_current_liabilities.label: Other Current Liabilities
growth_other_current_liabilities.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_operating_lease_liability_current.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
growth_operating_lease_liability_current.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

growth_finance_lease_liability_current.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current
growth_finance_lease_liability_current.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

growth_total_current_liabilities.label: Total Current Liabilities
growth_total_current_liabilities.description: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

growth_long_term_debt.label: Long-Term Debt
growth_long_term_debt.description: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

growth_capital_lease_obligations.label: Capital Lease Obligations
growth_capital_lease_obligations.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

growth_operating_lease_liability_noncurr.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
growth_operating_lease_liability_noncurr.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

growth_noncurrent_deferred_revenue.label: Noncurrent Deferred Revenue
growth_noncurrent_deferred_revenue.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

growth_noncurrent_deferred_tax_liabiliti.label: Noncurrent Deferred & Payable Income Tax Liabilities
growth_noncurrent_deferred_tax_liabiliti.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

growth_other_noncurrent_liabilities.label: Other Noncurrent Operating Liabilities
growth_other_noncurrent_liabilities.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_total_noncurrent_liabilities.label: Total Noncurrent Liabilities
growth_total_noncurrent_liabilities.description: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_total_liabilities.label: Total Liabilities
growth_total_liabilities.description: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

growth_common_equity.label: Common Stock
growth_common_equity.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

growth_accumulated_other_comprehensive_i.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income / (Loss)
growth_accumulated_other_comprehensive_i.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

growth_total_common_equity.label: Total Common Equity
growth_total_common_equity.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

growth_total_equity.label: Total Preferred & Common Equity
growth_total_equity.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

growth_total_equity_and_noncontrolling_i.label: Total Equity & Noncontrolling Interests
growth_total_equity_and_noncontrolling_i.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

growth_total_liabilities_and_equity.label: Total Liabilities & Shareholders' Equity
growth_total_liabilities_and_equity.description: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

growth_net_income.label: Consolidated Net Income / (Loss)
growth_net_income.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

growth_net_income_continuing.label: Net Income / (Loss) Continuing Operations
growth_net_income_continuing.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

growth_depreciation_expense.label: Depreciation Expense
growth_depreciation_expense.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

growth_amortization_expense.label: Amortization Expense
growth_amortization_expense.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

growth_other_depreciation_and_amortizati.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization
growth_other_depreciation_and_amortizati.description: Synthetic balancing plug derived from Depreciation and Amortization minus explicitly mapped children.

growth_depreciation_and_amortization.label: Depreciation and Amortization
growth_depreciation_and_amortization.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives.

growth_stock_based_compensation.label: Stock-Based Compensation
growth_stock_based_compensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

growth_deferred_income_tax.label: Deferred Income Tax
growth_deferred_income_tax.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

growth_gain_loss_on_sale_of_assets.label: Gain / (Loss) on Sale of Assets
growth_gain_loss_on_sale_of_assets.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

growth_noncash_adjustments_to_net_income.label: Non-Cash Adjustments To Reconcile Net Income
growth_noncash_adjustments_to_net_income.description: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

growth_other_operating_activities.label: Other Operating Activities
growth_other_operating_activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other, in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

growth_change_in_accounts_receivable.label: Change in Accounts Receivable
growth_change_in_accounts_receivable.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

growth_change_in_nontrade_receivables.label: Change in Vendor Non-trade Receivables
growth_change_in_nontrade_receivables.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables classified as other.

growth_change_in_inventories.label: Change in Inventories
growth_change_in_inventories.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

growth_change_in_accounts_payable.label: Change in Accounts Payable
growth_change_in_accounts_payable.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

growth_change_in_other_operating_assets_.label: Change in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, net
growth_change_in_other_operating_assets_.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

growth_increase_decrease_in_operating_ca.label: Changes in Operating Assets and Liabilities, net
growth_increase_decrease_in_operating_ca.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset and (increase) decrease in liability, used in operating activity in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

growth_net_cash_from_continuing_operatin.label: Net Cash From Continuing Operating Activities
growth_net_cash_from_continuing_operatin.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

growth_net_cash_from_operating_activitie.label: Net Cash From Operating Activities
growth_net_cash_from_operating_activitie.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

growth_purchase_of_plant_property_and_eq.label: Purchase of Property, Plant & Equipment
growth_purchase_of_plant_property_and_eq.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

growth_acquisitions.label: Acquisitions
growth_acquisitions.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

growth_purchase_of_investments.label: Purchase of Investments
growth_purchase_of_investments.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

growth_sale_of_investments.label: Sale of Investments
growth_sale_of_investments.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

growth_maturity_of_investments.label: Maturity of Investments
growth_maturity_of_investments.description: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

growth_other_investing_activities_net.label: Other Investing Activities, net
growth_other_investing_activities_net.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

growth_net_cash_from_continuing_investin.label: Net Cash From Continuing Investing Activities
growth_net_cash_from_continuing_investin.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

growth_net_cash_from_investing_activitie.label: Net Cash From Investing Activities
growth_net_cash_from_investing_activitie.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

growth_repayment_of_debt.label: Repayment of Debt
growth_repayment_of_debt.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_repurchase_of_common_equity.label: Repurchase of Common Equity
growth_repurchase_of_common_equity.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

growth_payment_of_dividends.label: Payment of Dividends
growth_payment_of_dividends.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

growth_issuance_of_debt.label: Issuance of Debt
growth_issuance_of_debt.description: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

growth_issuance_of_common_equity.label: Issuance of Common Equity
growth_issuance_of_common_equity.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

growth_tax_withholding_share_based_compe.label: Tax Withholding for Share-Based Compensation
growth_tax_withholding_share_based_compe.description: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

growth_other_financing_activities_net.label: Other Financing Activities, net
growth_other_financing_activities_net.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

growth_net_cash_from_continuing_financin.label: Net Cash From Continuing Financing Activities
growth_net_cash_from_continuing_financin.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

growth_net_cash_from_financing_activitie.label: Net Cash From Financing Activities
growth_net_cash_from_financing_activitie.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

growth_net_change_in_cash.label: Net Change in Cash & Equivalents
growth_net_change_in_cash.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in cash and cash equivalents. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a debit balance consistent with its label.

growth_cash_at_beginning_of_period.label: Cash at Beginning of Period
growth_cash_at_beginning_of_period.description: Cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and restricted cash equivalents at the beginning of the reporting period. Derived from the previous period's ending balance.

growth_cash_at_end_of_period.label: Cash at End of Period
growth_cash_at_end_of_period.description: Cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and restricted cash equivalents at the end of the reporting period.

growth_cash_interest_paid.label: Cash Interest Paid
growth_cash_interest_paid.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

growth_cash_income_taxes_paid.label: Cash Income Taxes Paid
growth_cash_income_taxes_paid.description: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

growth_short_term_debt_net.label: Short-Term Debt, net
growth_short_term_debt_net.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
